name: inspect_elf_notes
description: Inspect one explicit local ELF32/ELF64 image's PT_NOTE program headers and SHT_NOTE sections without executing it or opening a disassembler. Returns note-table file ranges, owners, types, descriptor SHA-256 and hex previews, plus GNU build-id, ABI-tag and gold-version fields and Linux CORE process, mapping, signal, and auxv notes when those descriptors match. A missing table is observed absence of those declarations, not proof the image never carried notes in another container. Reads a stable regular file; malformed ELF headers, truncated notes and exhausted budgets return no partial success. Portable on supported Node hosts; no debug package or catalog is required.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

max_entries.description: Maximum note entries to examine across every table; exceeding the budget fails without partial success

max_file_bytes.description: Maximum stable artifact bytes to read (default 64 MiB)

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to an ELF image
